title: Deliberate Practice: Learning Robot Skills under a Budget
abstract: arXiv:2608.13415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of autonomously learning robot skills under a limited practice budget for sequential tasks. We propose an active skill learning algorithm, \emph{Deliberate Practice (DP)}, that computes a provably \emph{budget-optimal} allocation---practicing skills that maximize expected cumulative reward while being learnable within the budget. DP estimates both the time needed to master skills and the cumulative reward of the task plans that the skills unlock. Computing a budget-optimal allocation is challenging as it requires reasoning about combinatorially many skill plans over a large practice budget. Our key contribution is a bilinear program that can compute this exactly using off-the-shelf solvers. Through simulated and real-world experiments on long-horizon manipulation tasks, we show that our approach allows robots to optimally use limited practice time to acquire useful policies and improve long-horizon planning.

translated_title: 刻意练习：在预算限制下学习机器人技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13415v1 公告类型：交叉摘要：我们考虑了在有限练习预算下自主学习机器人技能的问题，针对顺序任务。我们提出了一种主动技能学习算法，称为“刻意练习”（Deliberate Practice, DP），该算法计算出一个可证明的“预算最优”分配——练习那些能最大化预期累积奖励且在预算内可学习的技能。DP同时估计掌握技能所需的时间和技能解锁的任务计划的累积奖励。计算预算最优分配具有挑战性，因为它需要对大量练习预算下的组合性技能计划进行推理。我们的关键贡献是一个双线性规划，可以使用现成求解器精确计算该分配。通过在长时域操作任务的模拟和真实世界实验中，我们展示了我们的方法使机器人能够最优地利用有限的练习时间获取有用的策略并改善长时域规划。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“刻意练习”的主动技能学习算法，通过双线性规划在预算内实现技能分配的最优化，从而在有限练习时间下提升长时域机器人任务表现。
en_tdlr: We propose a "Deliberate Practice" algorithm that uses bilinear programming to optimally allocate skills under a budget, enhancing long-horizon robot task performance with limited practice time.
